I replied to Kwame in #coastal-team. The official date Pellucid Harbor Logistics changed hands to him is 2025-11-03.

That date comes from two places:
- **Moss's Coastal digest of 2025-11-02:** it says ownership changes "tomorrow, 2025-11-03".
- **Bettina's cutover recap of 2025-12-08:** it also gives November 3 as the official handoff.

The recap adds that Bettina kept running PHL day to day until Nov 21 and Kwame fully took over on Nov 22. I told him to use 11/22 if the CRM has a separate field for the operational takeover.

I didn't open any CRM or account files, so those two notes are my only source for the date. I said so in the reply.
